'''2007 Minnesota State Championship Brandon Brist DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Brist]] at [[2007 Minnesota State Championship]].

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif}}
